Hi Lisa — thanks for the note and sorry for the delay. We can share the materials; brief summary below and next steps.

Scope and artifacts available:
- Engagement date: April 2027 (contracted black-box pen test focused on Hosted API endpoints, auth flows, and multi-tenant isolation boundaries).
- Deliverables: redacted full technical report (encrypted), executive summary (PDF), remediation tracker CSV, and test evidence thumbnails.
- Redaction: we apply partner/customer redaction by default (customer names, sample data). We can provide an additional minimally redacted copy under a signed access agreement if required.

Secure delivery options (choose one):
1) Presigned S3 download (72-hour expiry, single IP restriction optional) — we provide link + one-time access token.
2) Short-lived access on our secure evidence portal (SAML/2FA) — requires provisioning a reviewer account (preferred for longer retention).
3) Encrypted package via our corp SFTP (available for enterprise contracts).

If you’re willing to accept the presigned link option, please reply with the list of authorized reviewers (name + company email) and we’ll send a DocuSign access agreement to sign. Once DocuSign is complete, we’ll issue the presigned URL.

I’m looping in Ben (security) and Lauren (legal) on this thread to coordinate redaction/DocuSign.

Best,
